title: Fried Corn Nuggets
description: Easy to make and enjoy as a side dish or appetizer, these deep-fried sweet corn nuggets require simple ingredients and low effort.
ingredients: 2 pounds frozen white shoepeg corn, thawed and drained
4 cups yellow cornmeal, or more as needed
1.5 cups enriched flour, or more as needed

steps.text: Mix corn, cornmeal, flour, sugar, and salt together in a large bowl until it forms a paste. If the mixture is runny, add equal amounts of flour and cornmeal to reach a paste-like consistency.

Cover a sheet of waxed paper with a light dusting of flour. Place a tablespoon of the corn mixture on the waxed paper and roll into a ball. Repeat with remaining batter, adding more flour to the wax paper as needed.
Heat oil in a deep-fryer or large saucepan to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Place batches of nuggets into the hot oil and fry until golden, 2 to 2 1/2 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
